plan.summary:
Raises the upload retry limit from 3 to 5 attempts in `config/upload.yaml`.

- `retry.max_attempts` changes from 3 to 5.
- `backoff_ms` stays at 200.
- A comment-only edit in the same file is left out as noise.
plan.riskRationale: One config value changes. It allows more retries, which can raise upload load or total retry time on failure. No code or schema changes.
plan.storyArc: One config change: uploads may now retry up to five times instead of three.

topics.title: Raise upload retry limit to five attempts
topics.narrativeBrief: What does the retry setting change? `max_attempts` goes from 3 to 5 while `backoff_ms` stays 200. The writer should verify whether the retry count includes the first attempt, and whether the backoff is fixed or grows.
